description: Labelled real papers, reports and books for scripts/research_bench.py. Files are not committed: `--download` fetches each `url` into the cache and checks `sha256`. `filename` is the name the document is indexed under. `labels` describe the file in hand; `accept` lists other values a careful reader would also accept as correct for this file. Bump `version` whenever an entry, a label or a file changes: numbers compare only within one version.
